verdict: No unresolved P0, P1 or P2 source finding in the reviewed delta.

evidence.claim: The memo derives only messages and Tagged_row/entry pairs from its complete two input values; it reads no workspace, keeper, state, live logs or preview data.
Both timeline and layout list must be physically identical for reuse. A new timeline rebuilds row tags even if upstream layout entries can be reused.
msg_entry and msg_identity anchor fields are immutable records/variants. The repository scan found no mutable me_ field or me_ field assignment in bin/test.
Upstream chat rows include keeper/history/session/settled/selected-transcript revision/queue/tool state in their reuse boundary. Visible timeline includes visibility state.
Layout reuse covers keeper, width, previews, memory/reasoning/origin/tools, file changes, calls, palette and owners. Preview generation copies list spine to invalidate dependent indexes.
Search index consumes immutable row identity/role/request/phase/sequence/reply source only. It does not consume workspace or layout state; stable row tags safely preserve its index.
Request-owner diagnostic de-duplication and live/polled/held/pending/child/native projection remain downstream of the new memo and keep their existing keys/derivations.
The cache is a single-slot derived value; it adds no durable source or wire/API variant. It memoizes no row rendering, mutable live turn_log or computed preview body.

limits: No measured end-to-end latency, GC reduction or allocation improvement is established by this source review.
Source review does not establish compilation or runtime search/pin semantics; candidate-head native build and existing semantic suites remain separate evidence.
Mapping work moved between timing-stage boundaries, so component-stage timing attribution should not be compared as an overall speedup.
